transcript.en: Hello everyone, welcome back to EnglishPod.
And today we're bringing you the second part of Christmas Chronicles.
transcript.zh: 今天我们为大家带来《圣诞纪事》的第二部分。

transcript.en: Another Christmas lesson to get you in the Christmas spirit.
transcript.zh: 又一节圣诞课程，让大家感受圣诞氛围。

transcript.en: Christmas and useful language for all of our listeners today.
transcript.zh: 今天为所有听众带来圣诞节和实用语言。

transcript.en: In today's lesson, we'll be learning some great Christmas vocabulary.
transcript.zh: 今天的课程中，我们将学习一些很棒的圣诞词汇。
以及与警察相关的词汇。

transcript.en: Now, Christmas, police vocabulary, how exactly does that fit together?
transcript.zh: 那么，圣诞节、警察词汇，这两者到底怎么联系在一起呢？

transcript.en: But here at EnglishPod, we can make anything happen.
transcript.zh: 但在 EnglishPod，我们可以让任何事情发生。

transcript.en: So that's why we have done this.
So, let's take a look at our vocabulary preview for this lesson.
transcript.zh: 那么，我们来看看今天课程的词汇预览。

transcript.en: In today's vocabulary preview, we've got two words from our dialogue that you will need to know to understand this dialogue.
transcript.zh: 在今天的词汇预览中，我们从对话中选了两个词，你需要了解它们才能理解这段对话。

transcript.en: And this is the plural of the word elf.
transcript.zh: 这是 elf（精灵）这个词的复数形式。

transcript.en: Our next word is candy cane.
transcript.zh: 我们的下一个词是 candy cane（糖果拐杖）。

transcript.en: So a candy cane is a traditional Christmas candy, right?
transcript.zh: 所以 candy cane 是一种传统的圣诞糖果，对吧？

transcript.en: And it kind of shaped like a J?
Yeah, you hang them on the tree and you eat them at Christmas time.
transcript.zh: 是的，你把它们挂在树上，圣诞节的时候吃。

transcript.en: Okay, well, I guess we're ready to listen to our dialogue for the first time.
transcript.zh: 好的，我想我们可以第一次来听我们的对话了。

transcript.en: And it's going to be kind of fast, but...
Don't worry if you don't understand everything because we'll come back and talk about some of the language later.
transcript.zh: 如果你没有全部听懂，不用担心，因为我们稍后会回来讲解其中一些语言点。

transcript.en: Really, fellas, you can't take me to jail.
transcript.zh: 说真的，伙计们，你们不能把我关进监狱。

transcript.en: Don't you know who I am?
Kris Kringle, you know, Papa Noel, Pere Noel, Babbo Natale, sheng dan lao ren!
transcript.zh: 克里斯·克林格，你知道的，圣诞老人，Papa Noel，Pere Noel，Babbo Natale，圣诞老人！

transcript.en: Yeah, yeah, we've heard that one before, haven't we, Joe?
transcript.zh: 是的是的，这个我们以前听过，对吧乔？

transcript.en: Yeah, last week we booked this guy who claimed to be the tooth fairy!
transcript.zh: 是啊，上周我们还抓了一个自称是牙仙子的家伙！

transcript.en: It's Christmas Eve and I have all these presents to deliver!
transcript.zh: 今天是平安夜，我还有这么多礼物要送！
你们的圣诞精神哪去了？

transcript.en: What will happen when all the children wake up tomorrow and don't find any gifts in their stockings?
transcript.zh: 明天孩子们醒来发现袜子里没有礼物，该怎么办？

transcript.en: Sorry, buddy, you were parked in a no-parking zone, you were speeding, and you have no ID!
transcript.zh: 抱歉了兄弟，你违规停在了禁停区，你超速了，而且你没有身份证！

transcript.en: Besides that, even if we let you go now, your sleigh has been impounded and those reindeer were taken to the city zoo.
transcript.zh: 除此之外，就算我们现在放你走，你的雪橇已经被扣押了，那些驯鹿也被送到市动物园了。
哇哦，他们在射糖果拐杖！

transcript.en: Mayday, Mayday, we are under heavy attack!
Okay, so Santa has escaped from the police car.
transcript.zh: 好了，圣诞老人从警车里逃出来了。

transcript.en: It's like a war over there.
I know, I mean, those elves are...
transcript.zh: 我知道，我是说，那些精灵真是……

transcript.en: Okay, well, we can take a look at some great vocabulary from this dialogue.
transcript.zh: 好的，我们来看看这段对话中一些很棒的词汇。

transcript.en: Why don't we start with our language takeaway for today?
transcript.zh: 不如从今天的「语言要点」开始吧？

transcript.en: In today's language takeaway, we have five really important words that we hope you will take away from the lesson.
transcript.zh: 在今天的语言要点中，我们有五个非常重要的词，希望大家能从本节课中学到。

transcript.en: Exactly, and the first word that we have today is booked.
transcript.zh: 没错，今天的第一个词是 booked。

transcript.en: Booked is another way of saying...
Yeah, it's a slang word, hey?
So, Santa was speeding because he was...
transcript.zh: 所以，圣诞老人超速是因为他……

transcript.en: That's when your car gets arrested.
Yeah, they take your car to car jail.
transcript.zh: 是的，他们把车带到「车监狱」。

transcript.en: Okay, so my car is in car jail.
transcript.zh: 好的，所以我的车进了「车监狱」。

transcript.en: Okay, so the police take my car and I have to...
transcript.zh: 好的，所以警察把我的车拖走了，我必须……

transcript.en: Let's move to our next word, ruined.
transcript.zh: 我们来看下一个词，ruined（被毁了）。

transcript.en: We have a few examples for us to listen to, to understand the meaning of this word.
transcript.zh: 我们来听几个例子，来理解这个词的含义。

transcript.en: It's been raining for five days.
You've ruined my favorite pair of jeans.
transcript.zh: 你毁了我最喜欢的一条牛仔裤。

transcript.en: Sam, you've been caught stealing from the company.
transcript.zh: Sam，你偷公司东西被抓到了。

transcript.en: Your chances for a promotion are ruined.
Okay, great examples and basically ruined means...
transcript.zh: 好的，很棒的几个例子，基本上 ruined 的意思是……

transcript.en: So, now for our last word.
transcript.zh: 那么，现在来看我们最后一个词。

transcript.en: Okay, so now for our last word and language takeaway, backup.
transcript.zh: 好的，现在来看语言要点中的最后一个词，backup。

transcript.en: So, when you call for backup, you call for help.
transcript.zh: 所以，当你呼叫 backup 时，就是在呼叫支援。

transcript.en: Yeah, you see it all the time in war movies, police, call for backup.
transcript.zh: 是的，你在战争片、警察片里经常看到，呼叫支援。

transcript.en: So, important to point out that here, the pronunciation and stress of this phrase is really important, hey?
transcript.zh: 所以，需要指出的是，这个短语的发音和重音非常重要，对吧？

transcript.en: So, both words are stressed at about the same level, hey?
transcript.zh: 所以，两个词的重音程度大致相同，对吧？

transcript.en: Because if you were to say back up...
transcript.zh: 因为如果你说 back up……

transcript.en: With those words in mind, it's time for us to listen to the dialogue a second time.
transcript.zh: 带着这些词汇，是时候听第二遍对话了。

transcript.en: Really, fellas, you can't take me to jail.
transcript.zh: 说真的，伙计们，你们不能把我关进监狱。

transcript.en: Don't you know who I am?
Kris Kringle, you know, Papa Noel, Pere Noel, Babbo Natale, sheng dan lao ren!
transcript.zh: 克里斯·克林格，你知道的，圣诞老人，Papa Noel，Pere Noel，Babbo Natale，圣诞老人！

transcript.en: Yeah, yeah, we've heard that one before, haven't we, Joe?
transcript.zh: 是的是的，这个我们以前听过，对吧乔？

transcript.en: Yeah, last week we booked this guy who claimed to be the tooth fairy!
transcript.zh: 是啊，上周我们还抓了一个自称是牙仙子的家伙！

transcript.en: It's Christmas Eve and I have all these presents to deliver!
transcript.zh: 今天是平安夜，我还有这么多礼物要送！
你们的圣诞精神哪去了？

transcript.en: What will happen when all the children wake up tomorrow and don't find any gifts in their stockings?
transcript.zh: 明天孩子们醒来发现袜子里没有礼物，该怎么办？

transcript.en: Sorry, buddy, you were parked in a no-parking zone, you were speeding, and you have no ID!
transcript.zh: 抱歉了兄弟，你违规停在了禁停区，你超速了，而且你没有身份证！

transcript.en: Besides that, even if we let you go now, your sleigh has been impounded and those reindeer were taken to the city zoo.
transcript.zh: 除此之外，就算我们现在放你走，你的雪橇已经被扣押了，那些驯鹿也被送到市动物园了。
哇哦，他们在射糖果拐杖！

transcript.en: Mayday, Mayday, we are under heavy attack!
Okay, so without the sound effects and without any noise, I think it's much more clear now,
transcript.zh: 好了，去掉音效和噪音，我觉得现在清晰多了，
没那么戏剧化，但语言点很好。

transcript.en: Speaking of good language, there's some great phrases I want to look at in this dialogue,
transcript.zh: 说到好的语言点，对话中还有一些很棒的短语我想看一下，

transcript.en: and so let's do that in Putting It Together.
transcript.zh: 所以我们在「学以致用」部分来做吧。

transcript.en: We have two phrases in Putting It Together that we want to show you how you can use in many different situations.
transcript.zh: 在「学以致用」部分，我们有两个短语想展示给大家，可以在很多不同场景中使用。

transcript.en: In the dialogue, we heard this.
transcript.zh: 在对话中，我们听到了这个。

transcript.en: Last week we booked this guy who claimed to be a tooth fairy.
transcript.zh: 上周我们抓了一个自称是牙仙子的家伙。

transcript.en: Last week we booked this guy who claimed to be a tooth fairy.
transcript.zh: 上周我们抓了一个自称是牙仙子的家伙。

transcript.en: So when you claim to be something, you're saying that you are something, but it might not be true, right?
transcript.zh: 所以当你 claim to be（自称是）某个人时，你在说你是某个人，但这可能不是真的，对吧？

transcript.en: So for example, you can say, this woman claimed to be your wife.
transcript.zh: 所以例如，你可以说，这个女人自称是你的妻子。

transcript.en: We have a few other examples of how you can use the phrase claim to.
transcript.zh: 我们有几个关于如何使用 claim to 这个短语的其他例子。

transcript.en: Daniel claimed to be the son of a government minister, but later we found out that he was lying.
transcript.zh: Daniel 自称是政府部长的儿子，但后来我们发现他在撒谎。

transcript.en: The criminals claim to have a gun.
This man here is claiming to know your father.
transcript.zh: 这边这个人声称认识你父亲。

transcript.en: Just by putting it together with another verb means something different, but still expresses that same idea.
transcript.zh: 只需把它与另一个动词搭配使用，就能表达不同的意思，但仍然传达同样的概念。

transcript.en: She claimed to have a baby or something.
transcript.zh: 她声称有个孩子之类的。

transcript.en: So let's move to our next phrase.
transcript.zh: 那么我们来看下一个短语。

transcript.en: So in the dialogue, they said we're under heavy attack.
transcript.zh: 在对话中，他们说 we're under heavy attack（我们受到猛烈攻击）。

transcript.en: You can also use this phrase in a couple of other ways.
transcript.zh: 你还可以在其他几种方式中使用这个短语。
我们受到猛烈火力攻击。

transcript.en: The prime minister is under heavy security.
transcript.zh: 首相处于严密安保之下。

transcript.en: So if you're under heavy fire.
transcript.zh: 所以如果你 under heavy fire。

transcript.en: Means that there's a lot of fire.

transcript.zh: 是的，不是着火的那种火。

transcript.en: And if you're under heavy security.
It means that you have a lot of security, a lot of bodyguards or a lot of.
transcript.zh: 意思是你有大量的安保，很多保镖或很多……

transcript.en: Like a prime minister or president would be under heavy security.
transcript.zh: 像首相或总统会处于严密安保之下。

transcript.en: Really good phrases and with this, we can listen to our dialogue a third time.
transcript.zh: 非常好的短语，有了这些，我们可以听第三遍对话了。

transcript.en: Really, fellas, you can't take me to jail.
transcript.zh: 说真的，伙计们，你们不能把我关进监狱。

transcript.en: Don't you know who I am?
Kris Kringle, you know, Papa Noel, Pere Noel, Babbo Natale, sheng dan lao ren!
transcript.zh: 克里斯·克林格，你知道的，圣诞老人，Papa Noel，Pere Noel，Babbo Natale，圣诞老人！

transcript.en: Yeah, yeah, we've heard that one before, haven't we, Joe?
transcript.zh: 是的是的，这个我们以前听过，对吧乔？

transcript.en: Yeah, last week we booked this guy who claimed to be the tooth fairy!
transcript.zh: 是啊，上周我们还抓了一个自称是牙仙子的家伙！

transcript.en: It's Christmas Eve and I have all these presents to deliver!
transcript.zh: 今天是平安夜，我还有这么多礼物要送！
你们的圣诞精神哪去了？

transcript.en: What will happen when all the children wake up tomorrow and don't find any gifts in their stockings?
transcript.zh: 明天孩子们醒来发现袜子里没有礼物，该怎么办？

transcript.en: Sorry, buddy, you were parked in a no-parking zone, you were speeding, and you have no ID!
transcript.zh: 抱歉了兄弟，你违规停在了禁停区，你超速了，而且你没有身份证！

transcript.en: Besides that, even if we let you go now, your sleigh has been impounded and those reindeer were taken to the city zoo.
transcript.zh: 除此之外，就算我们现在放你走，你的雪橇已经被扣押了，那些驯鹿也被送到市动物园了。
哇哦，他们在射糖果拐杖！

transcript.en: Mayday, Mayday, we are under heavy attack!
So, Marco, the police mentioned something about the tooth fairy.
transcript.zh: 那么，Marco，警察提到了牙仙子的事情。

transcript.en: I don't know, maybe some of our listeners don't know this story about the tooth fairy.
transcript.zh: 不知道，也许有些听众不知道牙仙子的故事。

transcript.en: So can I go ahead and say it?
Okay, well, when you're small and you lose a tooth.
transcript.zh: 好的，嗯，当你还小的时候，掉了一颗牙。

transcript.en: Yeah, you put it underneath your pillow and then you go to sleep.
transcript.zh: 是的，你把它放在枕头底下，然后去睡觉。

transcript.en: And then in the night, the tooth fairy comes into the house, flies into the house, sneaks under your pillow, takes the tooth and puts money there.
transcript.zh: 然后在夜里，牙仙子来到你家，飞进屋里，偷偷钻到你的枕头底下，拿走牙齿然后放上钱。

transcript.en: So this is a story that parents tell their kids about what happens to their baby teeth.
transcript.zh: 所以这是父母给孩子们讲的关于乳牙去向的故事。

transcript.en: And they get money in exchange for it.
transcript.zh: 而且他们会因此得到钱。

transcript.en: So I guess it takes away the sadness of losing that tooth.
transcript.zh: 所以我想这能减轻掉牙的伤心吧。

transcript.en: But in South America, for example, we have the tooth mouse.
transcript.zh: 但在南美洲，例如，我们有牙齿老鼠。

transcript.en: How does it call them in Spanish?
Oh, well, in some places it's called Ratoncito Perez.
transcript.zh: 哦，嗯，在一些地方它叫 Ratoncito Perez。

transcript.en: Like it has a last name Perez.
In other places, it's just called Ratoncito, which means mouse.
transcript.zh: 在其他地方，就叫 Ratoncito，意思是小老鼠。

transcript.en: Okay, so it'd be like tooth fairy Smith.
transcript.zh: 好的，所以那就像是「牙仙子 Smith」。

transcript.en: It's a little mouse that comes in and steals a little tooth from you and leaves money in exchange.
transcript.zh: 一只小老鼠来了，偷走你的小牙齿，然后留下钱作为交换。

transcript.en: So we go from Santa Claus to Guns and Wars to the tooth fairy.
transcript.zh: 所以我们从圣诞老人聊到枪战，再聊到牙仙子。

transcript.en: I hope you enjoyed today's lesson.
transcript.zh: 希望大家喜欢今天的课程。

transcript.en: If you have any questions or comments about the lesson, please visit our website, EnglishPod.com.
transcript.zh: 如果对课程有任何问题或评论，请访问我们的网站 EnglishPod.com。

transcript.en: We've got some Christmas shopping to do.
transcript.zh: 我们还有圣诞采购要做。

transcript.en: So we'll see you guys later.

dialogue.en: A: Really, fellas, you can't take me to jail! Don't you know who I am? Kris Kringle, you know, Papa Noel, Pere Noel, Babbo Natale, sheng dan lao ren!
dialogue.zh: A：说真的，伙计们，你们不能把我关进监狱！你们不知道我是谁吗？克里斯·克林格，你知道的，圣诞老人，Papa Noel，Pere Noel，Babbo Natale，圣诞老人！

dialogue.en: B: Yeah, Yeah, we've heard that one before, haven't we Joe?
dialogue.zh: B：是的是的，这个我们以前听过，对吧乔？

dialogue.en: C: Yeah, last week we booked this guy who claimed to be the tooth fairy! Can you believe that?
dialogue.zh: C：是啊，上周我们还抓了一个自称是牙仙子的家伙！你敢信吗？

dialogue.en: A: It's Christmas Eve and I have all these Presents to deliver! Where is your Christmas spirit? What will happen when all the children wake up tomorrow and don't find any gifts in their stockings?
dialogue.zh: A：今天是平安夜，我还有这么多礼物要送！你们的圣诞精神哪去了？明天孩子们醒来发现袜子里没有礼物，该怎么办？

dialogue.en: B: Sorry buddy, you were parked in a no-parking zone, you were speeding, and you have no ID!
dialogue.zh: B：抱歉了兄弟，你违规停在了禁停区，你超速了，而且你没有身份证！

dialogue.en: C: Besides that, even if we let you go now, your sleigh has been impounded and those reindeer were taken to the city zoo.
dialogue.zh: C：除此之外，就算我们现在放你走，你的雪橇已经被扣押了，那些驯鹿也被送到市动物园了。

dialogue.en: A: What! This is unbelievable! What's this world coming to? Christmas is ruined!
dialogue.zh: A：什么！难以置信！这世界变成什么样了？圣诞节被毁了！

dialogue.en: C: What's that up ahead? It looks like... elves!! Elves!! Whoa, they're shooting candy canes! Mayday, Mayday, we are under heavy attack! We need backup!
dialogue.zh: C：前面那是什么？看起来像是……小精灵！！小精灵！！哇哦，他们在射糖果拐杖！Mayday，Mayday，我们受到猛烈攻击！请求支援！
